source_read: Exact e099 bootloader_random_esp32s3.c, hw_random.c and periph_ctrl.c RCC entry/exit implementations
Manufacturer pinnedSDK5.3 RNG API and current ADC183 erratum for rev0.2; no DMA exemption inferred
Current product PROD02 requires qualified uniformly sampled scalar; this experimental lot admits no identity generation/import
conditions: Existing833 hardware/source remain immutable; merge current main99332719 into same S3 worktree first, preserving private source history and source-blob equivalence; no extra checkout or unneeded core suite replay
Implement narrow fail-closed provider/FFI/ownership/readback/wipe only for known public scalar3 and fixed public draws; no entropy_ok or real-key capability from experimental success

ADC183 DIGADC2/doubleSAR remains a production-source uncertainty: varied output cannot close it. Before any production admission require applicable manufacturer evidence or a separately reviewed supported path. Limit any followup source question to the exact SAR1/SAR2-to-RNG path, not a new platform catalog

Do not add an unrequested FIPS/AIS certification or formal minimum-entropy campaign as a hidden milestone criterion; manufacturer-supported source behavior and applicable errata plus required fault/ownership evidence are the actual admission basis. Do not pretend gross screens measure entropy quality
RCC busy exit must preserve foreign refcount/registers; each lock/unlock path including changed-count failure must be balanced, no long lock across helper/draw/UI

Typed error/short/oversize/interruption exposes no partial buffer, fallback or signature; wipe exactly the owned32byte destination/staging and preserve guards, never trust a reported count as writable capacity

Readback after reset/clock gating must state which registers are readable/meaningful; no accepting observed values as a new expected baseline. Document helper leaves RC entropy clock enabled and changed source/register defaults
50ms between-call checks are not a hard return bound for a stuck call. Public diagnostic4draw limit and at most1new-aux fixture roundtrip; no retries until green

Power amendment is S3-only USB-only per explicit maintainer direction; no battery/supercap/independent-power dependency, E5 not applicable, future power-loss/local-reload obligation, task states/criteria/deps unchanged; preserve Pi/P4 profiles
existing_hardware_basis: S3OTG1c: actual622B signature verified with explicit identity; mainminimum34988B/USB3156B; DTRcancelledrequest; selectedbus/reset/RAM observations only. No realkey/custody admission.
